Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CRM.
Operating income reached $9.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 6% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
We generated $4.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.52 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Revenue guidance of $32.4 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
